title: packages/tui dead-code cleanup
summary: 19 small dead-code and dedup PRs from an in-depth scan of packages/tui. Each re-verified on v2, typechecked, and passed `bun run check`.

groups.title: package.json exports
groups.why: A stale export pointing at a deleted file, then 28 exports nothing imports (package is private).

prs.why: ./terminal-win32 points at a file deleted in #43604; node-ffi.d.ts lost its only user in the same commit.
Trims 28 export entries with zero consumers; keeps the 14 used by cli.

groups.title: Theme
groups.why: V1 theme leftovers after the V2 theme engine landed.

prs.why: Re-exports nobody imports through context/theme and theme/index.
~500 lines of V1 syntax generation; production uses the V2 generateSyntax.
addTheme/upsertTheme and an always-empty pluginThemes store; the V2 plugin API can't install themes.

groups.title: Config & context
groups.why: Unused v1 config aliases and fields nobody has ever read.

prs.why: TuiConfig alias, v1 Descriptions, and two Keybinds = { parse } value objects.
multiplexer/displayServer are written but never read anywhere in git history.

groups.title: Components
groups.why: Props and options no caller passes, plus one dedup.

prs.why: Prompt hint/right/showPlaceholder; their last caller was the V1 prompt plugin slot.
DialogSelect detailsColor/detailsWrap/categoryView are never set (titleWidth kept: it is set via shorthand).
TabPulse outerFlashTail has never been passed.
Identical clamp in tab-pulse and fade-in-text; share it like coast/smootherstep.

groups.title: mini
groups.why: The opencode mini frontend: unused helper, impossible branch, test-only option, one dedup.

prs.why: monoTruncateMiddle has no callers since fac875dba0.
runMiniFrontend always returned exitCode 0, so the CLI's process.exit branch was unreachable.
The thinking override is only passed by tests; the CLI stopped in 925c2423de.
Byte-identical requestOptions in two files; share it.

groups.title: Routes & plugins
groups.why: Never-passed props, a hook nothing sets, a command that can never run, one dedup.

prs.why: Sidebar overlay, PluginsDialog server, DiffViewerContent navigation, InlineTool iconColor/failure.
ComposerTab.onClose has had no setter since cb863b8ea5; plus an unused re-export.
session.unshare is hard-coded enabled: false; keybind entries kept so user configs still validate.
Identical A/D/M statusLabel in two files; share one named helper.
